transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Just... dealing with some things at work. 

Ever since I got this county safety award, certain people have been... well, they're twisting my inspection reports. They keep asking these pointed budget questions, like they're trying to make me look crooked. My supervisor says it's just a normal review, but... I can tell there's a coordinated effort to discredit me. 

So... yeah. That's why I'm here. I don't really know what else to say about it.
Have you heard voices when no one else was there?
No. I don't... no. I'm not hearing things. It's just the people at the office.
Do you believe for certain that your coworkers are deliberately trying to discredit you?

Yeah. I mean... like I said. It's not an accident. 

Ever since that award, they've been messing with my reports and... asking all those budget questions just to make me look crooked. My supervisor claims it's nothing, just a normal review, but... I know what I'm seeing. It's definitely coordinated. 

So... yeah. I'm certain.
Has anything happened that would be impossible in real life and made you think people are targeting you?
No. Nothing... impossible. Just what I told you. They're messing with my reports. It's just regular office stuff, just... targeted. That's all.
Do you ever feel that your thoughts are being controlled or put into your mind by someone else?
No. I... no. My thoughts are my own. I don't know why you'd ask that. Nobody is controlling my mind.
Have you noticed that you've become less interested in seeing people or doing things you used to enjoy?
No. Not really. I still do the things I like. I just... keep to myself a bit more right now, with everything going on at the job. But no, everything else is the same.
How long have you been convinced that your coworkers are coordinating against you?
It's been... about a year now. Yeah. Right around the time I got recognized for that county safety initiative. That's when it started.
Before this started at your current job, have you generally found it hard to trust other people?

No. Not really. I've always gotten along fine with people. I mean, I don't go out of my way to tell everyone my business, but... no, I didn't have any problems trusting people before this. It's just... this specific situation.
Have other people told you that your speech or behavior seems odd or hard to follow?
No. Nobody's said anything like that to me. I talk just fine.
Do you often feel that people are making hidden insults or threats when they speak to you, even when others say they are not?
No... not really. I haven't noticed anything like that. It's not about what they say to my face.
If someone showed you clear proof that your coworkers were not altering your reports, would you accept that?

I... I don't know what kind of proof you mean. Look, ever since I won that county safety award, things changed. Certain people started... twisting my inspection reports. And they keep asking me these really pointed questions about the budget. It's like they're trying to make me look crooked or something. My supervisor keeps telling me it's just normal review, but... I know what I see. There's a coordinated effort to discredit me. So, no... I wouldn't just accept it, because I know what they're doing.
Aside from this issue at work, have you had trouble keeping up with your usual work or daily responsibilities?

No... I get to work on time. I complete my inspections. I still go to church and... take care of myself. Everything else is fine. The only time there's a problem is... well, when people bring up those reports. Or start questioning my spending. Other than that, I just stick to my routine.
Outside of this situation at work, do you believe other people are also trying to harm, cheat, or conspire against you?
No... not really. I mean, it's just the people at work. Everyone else is... fine. I just do my job and go home.
Do you think there is any chance you could be mistaken about your coworkers coordinating against you?

No. I... I already explained this. I'm not mistaken. 

You don't just... suddenly get all these pointed budget questions for no reason. Not right after winning a safety award. They're twisting my reports because they want to make me look crooked. My supervisor can keep saying it's just a normal review, but... it's not. It's coordinated. I'm just... telling you what's actually happening. So, no.
